QuestInfo.name: She Remembers Me
QuestInfo.0: As #p1002104# instructed, you use the #m220000000# clocktower to travel to the past. Just as you arrive in the past, someone calls out your name.
QuestInfo.1:
The woman you first met in Ellin Forest mistook you for someone who lost their family and consoled you.
The Chief Explorer might know something about you.
Go to the #bCamp Conference Room#k and meet #bAthena Pierce#k like she said.
QuestInfo.2: You finally met #p2131000# in Ellin Forest. #p2131000# was glad to see you alive and well, but then learned that you have no recollection of the past and seemed sad to hear it.

0.0: Why are you standing there in a daze? Did you lose your way? Or maybe your family?
0.1: It's okay. There are many people like you here. You can all rely on each other to get by. Our ancestors before us would have done the same.
0.2: Go see Chief Explorer #bAthena Pierce#k to receive your mission. You can find her in the #bCamp Conference Room#k.

0.msg: (The Chief Explorer might know something about me. I should go see #bAthena Pierce#k like she said.)

npc.0: You still haven't gone to see #bAthena Pierce#k? She's in the #bCamp Conference Room#k in Altaire Camp.
